prompt: A thundering herd of massive brown oxen stampeding head-on toward the viewer across a dry grassland, packed shoulder to shoulder in a tight wedge, broad horned heads lowered, the lead ox largest and closest with curved ivory horns and flaring nostrils. Their churning hooves throw up clods of earth and torn grass. A thick boiling cloud of tan dust rises behind the herd. The background is a wide sunlit savannah of golden-green grass under a pale sky.

A herd of heavy brown oxen charging from left to right in side profile, overlapping muscular bodies with humped shoulders and curved horns, hooves pounding, smashing through a wooden rail fence that splinters and flies apart beneath the lead ox. A trail of tan dust streams behind them. The background is a rolling green grassland under a wide pale-blue sky.

A stampeding herd of dark-brown oxen surging diagonally toward the foreground across a churned green meadow, several horned heads visible layered front to back, the nearest beasts huge and lowered. Their hooves rip up the turf and a faint warm green glow rises from the torn grass and overturned earth. Tan dust haze billows behind the receding herd. The background is a deep emerald grassland fading into dusty haze.
